title: Data-Efficient LLM Safety Alignment Guided by Interpretable Features
abstract: arXiv:2611.16183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing large language models typically rely on massive fine-tuning datasets for safety alignment, which results in higher costs for safety alignment and often leads to the problem of over-refusal. We propose Less is Safer (LIS), a compact yet highly effective dataset for safety alignment, constructed through interpretable feature-guided selection and adversarial synthesis. Specifically, we leverage Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) activations to efficiently select prompts that cover diverse and interpretable safety features. Then, we employ a multi-agent adversarial synthesis framework to generate harmless prompts that nevertheless elicit unnecessary refusals. LIS contains only 2.4K samples, yet outperforms much larger datasets, e.g., TRIDENT-Core (26K), TRIDENT-Edge (19K) and WildJailbreak (262K), in overall performance on four safety and five over-refusal benchmarks. translated_title: 由可解释特征引导的数据高效大语言模型安全对齐
translated_abstract: 现有的大型语言模型通常依赖海量微调数据集进行安全对齐，这不仅导致安全对齐成本较高，还常常引发过度拒答问题。我们提出了“Less is Safer"（LIS），这是一个紧凑却极为高效的安全对齐数据集，通过可解释特征引导的选择和对抗性合成构建而成。具体而言，我们利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）激活来高效选择覆盖多样且可解释安全特征的提示词，随后采用多智能体对抗合成框架生成无害却会引发不必要拒答的提示词。LIS 仅包含 2.4K 样本，却在四个安全基准和五个过度拒答基准上的整体表现超越了规模大得多的数据集，例如 TRIDENT-Core（26K）、TRIDENT-Edge（19K）和 WildJailbreak（262K）。通过消融实验，我们证明无论是安全数据还是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“Less is Safer"（LIS）方法，利用稀疏自编码器可解释特征引导的选择与多智能体对抗性合成，构建出仅含2.4K样本的紧凑安全对齐数据集，其整体性能超越了规模大得多的数据集，实现了更低成本且减少过度拒答的大语言模型安全对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LIS, a compact 2.4K-sample safety alignment dataset built through interpretable SAE-guided prompt selection and multi-agent adversarial synthesis, which outperforms much larger datasets on safety and over-refusal benchmarks while achieving more cost-efficient alignment and reducing over-refusal.
